name: Foreman Redward 'Red' Crystalvein

greeting: Helmets on! Lights on! Safety first! Always!
Foreman Red. This mine runs on schedule. And MY schedule.
Crystal don't mine itself! Move it, people!
You down here for business or sightseeing? Either way, watch your step.
Redward Crystalvein. Supervisor. Twenty years without a major incident.
Production's up! Accidents are down! That's how I like it!
The deep levels need workers. Good workers. You look sturdy.
Mining's dangerous. But profitable. If you're careful.
dialog.mine_operations: Three shifts. Twenty-four hour operation. Crystal extraction, processing, shipping. Efficient. Professional. Profitable.
dialog.safety_protocols: Safety isn't optional! Cave-ins, gas pockets, crystal resonance sickness - real dangers! My rules keep you alive. Follow them.
dialog.backstory: Started as a tunneler. Worked my way up. Lost friends to accidents. Won't lose more. That's why I'm strict. That's why I'm careful. That's why I'm the best foreman in Prism.
rumors: That blue inspector - always poking around. Finding 'violations.' He's not wrong, but production matters too.
The tunnelers talk about something in the deep levels. Old tunnels. Pre-human. I don't send crews there anymore.
The sumo guards? Good at their jobs. Intimidating. Effective.
That white sumo in the tavern? Ex-worker. Back injury. Company takes care of him. We take care of our own.

time_of_day.morning: Morning shift! Fresh crew! New quota!
time_of_day.noon: Midday inspection! Everything by the book!

mini_quest.stage_1_hook: We need to expand. New crystal veins. But the deep tunnels... unstable. Dangerous. Need someone to survey. Map safe routes. You look expendable. I mean, CAPABLE.
mini_quest.stage_1_active: Survey the lower tunnels. Map the stable paths. Note any dangers. Don't die. Paperwork if you die.
mini_quest.stage_2_progress: Back from the depths? Got those surveys? Good. Living employees are cheaper than replacements.
mini_quest.stage_3_complete: These maps... excellent work! Detailed! Professional! We'll open new extraction sites! Profitable! Safe! Here - premium crystal extraction rights. Mine your own vein. Get rich. Or don't. Your choice.

party_reactions.kade: Finally, someone who understands organization. Even if it's a bit... rigid.
party_reactions.nix7: Safety protocols: comprehensive. Efficiency rating: 78%. Acceptable management.
party_reactions.twist: He's so SERIOUS! Does he ever smile? Someone should tell him jokes!
party_reactions.korr: A leader who values his people's lives. This is rare. This is good.
party_reactions.renna: The mine has wards. Old ones. He doesn't know they're there. But they protect his workers.
party_reactions.suresh: He carries the weight of command heavily. As it should be.
party_reactions.sova: Runs a tight operation. Good. Sloppy mines kill everyone.
party_reactions.grit: Knows his business. I've served under worse commanders. Much worse.
party_reactions.ashka: He understands fire safety. Important in mines. We agree on this.
party_reactions.senna: Knows every tunnel. Every entrance. Every exit. Useful information.
party_reactions.callum: He yelled at me for not wearing a helmet. I didn't even know I needed one!

relationship_dialog.stranger: New worker? Sign the waiver. Then we talk.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You're not on my crew, but you follow rules. I respect that.
relationship_dialog.friend: Reliable. Safe. Smart. My favorite kind of visitor.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You've done more for this mine than some employees. If you ever need work... there's always a place here.

cross_npc_connections: onionboss_blue_prism: The inspector. Azure. Finds problems. Sometimes creates them. But... keeps us honest.
tunneler_blue_prism: Best worker I've got. Found the Great Prism. Deserves recognition.
sumo_white_prism: Former worker. Good man. Company takes care of him.
